_README: Impressum data for dictivo.app (§ 5 DDG — the successor to § 5 TMG since May 2024).
The page at /impressum/ and its footer link DO NOT RENDER while any value below
still starts with 'FILL_IN'. That is deliberate: a half-filled Impressum published
to the web is worse than none. Fill the values, run `node scripts/generate-site.mjs`,
and the page, the footer link, and the sitemap entry all appear on their own.
This is a scaffold, not legal advice. Have the finished text reviewed before you
rely on it — the exact obligations depend on your Gewerbe status, whether you are
VAT-registered, and whether the guides count as journalistic-editorial content.
Field notes:
legalName    Your full legal name as an Einzelunternehmer. Not 'Dictivo'.
address      A real postal address that can receive mail. A P.O. box does not
satisfy § 5 DDG.
vatId        USt-IdNr per § 27a UStG. Leave empty ('') if you are a
Kleinunternehmer under § 19 UStG and have none — the row is
then omitted rather than left blank.
contentResponsible  § 18 Abs. 2 MStV. Usually the same person and address.
Leave empty to omit the section.
disputeResolution   § 36 VSBG. State plainly whether you take part in consumer
arbitration. Do NOT add a link to the EU ODR platform: it was shut
down on 2025-07-20 and linking to it is now itself a defect.
